E) DUE TO APPROACHING THE MAXIMUM NUMBER OF NOTAM MESSAGES IN SERIES
   C PER YEAR, STARTING WITH 04 OCT 2026, 0900 UTC, INFORMATION
   RELATING TO AIRSPACE RESERVATIONS (RESTRICTIONS),
   EXCEPT DANGER AREAS AND UNMANNED AIRCRAFT FLIGHTS,
   WILL BE ISSUED IN NOTAM SERIES R.
